question: INV-104 class 1 (consequence / opportunity-and-threat), condition (i) DESTRUCTION IS REAL: through the SD-070-trained observation->z_world compression, is the retained fraction R_1 of oracle-relevant class-1 access at or below 0.25, while the raw-input ceiling (NDP-3) clears 0.90?

answer.sign_note: R_1 is NEGATIVE on all three seeds: the trained compression yields LOWER oracle agreement than an untrained random projection of the same width.

method_note: Arithmetic over per-seed oracle_action_agreement in V3-EXQ-1008's arm_results; all three arms (ceiling / floor / compressed) are cells of the SAME run, so R_1 is computed within one substrate_hash with no cross-run mixing. The floor and compressed arms use the unrotated _diag variants (no re-basis), which is the form INV-104's R_k is defined on.
notes: Discharges ONE leg of INV-104 class 1 only. Conditions (ii) losses-blind, (iii) restoration-pays and (iv) not-just-more-supervision remain untested, so this is NOT support for INV-104 as a whole -- hence verdict inconclusive. NDP-1 (compression trained) holds: the SD-070 P0a warmup ran. NDP-6 (GOV-MATCHAUX-1 matched-arbitrary control) and NDP-7 are not applicable to this leg. NDP-5 (organism-level DV resolution) is NOT met on this substrate and is why the normative legs are blocked -- V3-EXQ-978 measured 0.2667 vs 0.2833 res/ep against a 1.0 competence floor (demonstrator anchor 45.75), an arm difference of one third of one 0.05 quantum with within-arm spread ~21x that difference. INTERPRETATION GATE: V3-EXQ-1002 returned H-C-geometry-mismatch, so per INV-104's conditional-interpretation clause the production readout is the admissible one; V3-EXQ-1008 then WEAKENED H-C to a linear content ceiling (no information-preserving re-basis -- zca, ldawhiten, fielddecode -- lifted agreement, while PCA-32 of the encoder's own 250-dim input reached 0.868). V3-EXQ-1010 (over-capacity decoder sweep, claimed/in flight at time of writing) is the outstanding corroborator: if it recovers the mapping at higher decoder capacity, R_1 at INV-104's own pinned 2x128 adapter capacity remains the defined statistic but its reading as content destruction rather than capacity limitation is contested.
